items.title: 65-inch flat-screen TV
items.description: A flat-screen display for presentations, research documentation and public encounters at the atelier. Acquisition is currently in progress.

items.title: Projection screen
items.description: A projection screen supporting presentations, workshops and public encounters at the atelier.

items.title: Large-format CO₂ laser cutter
items.description: A machine with a working area of at least 900 × 600 mm and pass-through capability for fabricating experimental structures and custom components.

items.title: Large-format 3 mm acrylic sheets
items.description: Sheets approximately 2000 × 1000 mm for laser-cut prototypes, kinetic structures and experimental fabrication.

items.title: Organza, tulle and technical textiles
items.description: Lightweight textiles for soft mechanisms, kinetic studies and material experiments.

items.title: Electronics and prototyping components
items.description: Electronic components and prototyping supplies for experimental circuits, sensors and embedded systems.

items.title: Robotics platforms for embodied AI research
items.description: Access to robotic hardware for experiments exploring embodiment, movement and interaction.

items.title: Access to scientific laboratories
items.description: Access to laboratory facilities and instruments for interdisciplinary artistic and scientific investigations.

items.title: Specialised fabrication facilities
items.description: Access to specialised machines and fabrication facilities for prototypes beyond the atelier’s current capabilities.

items.title: Electronics and embedded systems collaboration
items.description: Technical collaboration on electronic circuits, embedded firmware and experimental interactive systems.

items.title: Mechanical engineering assistance
items.description: Technical expertise in mechanisms, movement, structural design and experimental kinetic assemblies.
